correctness.rationale: The two-particle Abrams cubical model for 7 vertices has C2=105 unordered disjoint edge pairs and C1=105 edge-vertex cells, with no 3-cells. Independently constructed integer cubical differential D, 105x70 signed triangular product-torus matrix T, 70x35 local four-term relation matrix R, and a ten-support alternating six-vertex column. Verified D*T=0 and T*R=0 exactly. D has rank70 over F3; T has rank35 with primitive column Hermite basis and all 35 Smith entries one, so its image equals the entire integral kernel D. Local R Smith has 34 ones and one two; the augmented R|r_U has 35 ones, hence equals saturated ker(T). These integers prove quotient Z35⊕Z2 for local relations, and full H2=Z35 with correction. Finite integral matrices are exhaustively enumerated, not sampled, and unordered orientation signs are treated consistently.

originality.rationale: Ramos–Yun 2026 Theorem3.10 already identifies the complete-graph unordered two-point rational H2 representation and Betti rank, which is explicitly excluded as new; rationalization cannot detect an index-two integer relation lattice. Barnett 2010 thesis Chapter5 §5.3 studies complete-graph ordered two-particle intersection theory and rational Betti formulas, and the 2009 Barnett–Farber work provides foundational graph configurations, not the same oriented unordered 70-tori local relation Smith form.
